description: Is a domain name available? Check availability. Check if domain names are available across many extensions in one call, using each registry's official RDAP data (with DNS fallback). Creation and expiry dates, registrar and .com name suggestions.

domain.description: One domain (example.com) or a comma-separated list in domains= (e.g. tidydata.ai)

name.description: Name without extension to check across tlds (e.g. tidydata)

suggest.description: true to add available .com alternatives (getname.com, namehq.com...) (e.g. false)

name: domain_availability
title: Is a domain name available?
